cards.text: After this, Jesus goes out and sees a tax collector named Levi, sitting at the tax booth. Levi collects taxes. Me? Back in the junk drawer, the only thing I ever collected was DUST.

cards.question: Jesus sees Levi sitting at his tax booth and speaks to him. What does Jesus tell Levi?
Jesus tells Levi to follow Him. What does Levi do?

answers.text: Asks to finish his day first

cards.text: Levi gets up, leaves everything and follows Him, and then he hosts a great banquet for Jesus at his house. The man LEFT EVERYTHING, and I can't walk away from a tray of warm cookies without looking back three times!

cards.question: Levi hosts a great banquet for Jesus at his house. A large crowd of ___ is there.
True or false: everyone eating at Levi's banquet is a tax collector.

cards.text: But not everyone is cheering. The Pharisees, a group of religious leaders, and their scribes bring a complaint to Jesus' disciples.

cards.question: The Pharisees and their scribes complain to Jesus' disciples. What are they complaining about?

answers.text: Eating with tax collectors and sinners

cards.text: Jesus answers, and of ALL things, He starts talking about doctors.

cards.question: Answering the complaint about who He eats with, Jesus talks about doctors. True or false: He says it's the healthy who need a doctor.
Jesus says He has not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to ___.

cards.text: Next, Jesus hears that John's disciples, followers of John the Baptist, often fast and pray, and so do the Pharisees' disciples. Friend, I taste-test every batch I've EVER baked, so fasting is not my department.

cards.question: John's disciples and the Pharisees' disciples often fast and pray. What does Jesus hear His own disciples keep on doing?

cards.text: Jesus answers with a question, and He sets it at a wedding, with the bridegroom right there with the guests.

cards.question: Jesus asks if you can make the guests of the bridegroom ___ while He is with them.
True or false: Jesus says a time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from the guests.

cards.text: And then, Jesus says, they will fast. Whoa. I think that one's heavy.
Jesus also tells a parable, and it starts with clothes: no one tears a piece of cloth from a new garment and sews it on an old one. Good, because the only sewing I know is retying my apron strings.

cards.question: Jesus says that if someone sews a patch from a new garment onto an old one, the new garment gets torn too. True or false: He also says the patch will match the old garment.

cards.text: Then a second picture: no one pours new wine into old wineskins. And after my years in that junk drawer, I take that word OLD personally.

cards.question: Say someone pours new wine into old wineskins anyway. What does Jesus say happens?

answers.text: The skins burst and the wine spills
The skins stretch and hold it

cards.text: Burst skins, spilled wine, and the wineskins are ruined. It's like cramming a fresh batch into a cookie box held together with tape, and you KNOW how that ends.

cards.question: So instead, Jesus says, new wine is poured into ___ wineskins.
Jesus' last picture is someone who has just been drinking old wine. True or false: Jesus says that person doesn't want the new.

cards.text: And why not? Because, Jesus says, that person says, "The old is better."
